tasks.text: The monitor is the most important output device on a computer.
A printer allows us to see our work on paper.
A projector projects the image onto the wall in the classroom.
A laser printer prints text quickly and neatly.
A 3D printer can create real objects from plastic.
Monitor resolution determines the sharpness of the image.
A Braille printer prints with raised dots for the blind.
A plotter is a device suitable for making large-scale blueprints.
Headphones allow for private music listening.
